request: Remove duplicate customer records by ID.
question: When two records have the same ID, which record should survive?
why_it_matters: Keeping the first protects the original value; keeping the last applies the last supplied correction. Neither policy can infer real-world freshness without a timestamp.

task.title: Implement deduplicateById with a confirmed duplicate policy
task.description: Create src/deduplicate.mjs exporting deduplicateById(records). Inputs are arrays of objects with string IDs. Return a new array without mutating inputs. Preserve first-appearance ID order. Add test/deduplicate.test.mjs using node:test, covering empty input, unique IDs and the confirmed examples. The duplicate survivor policy is deliberately unresolved until clarification.

options.label: Keep the first supplied record
options.requirement: For each ID, retain the complete first record and ignore later duplicates. Preserve first-appearance ID order.

options.label: Keep the last supplied record
options.requirement: For each ID, retain the complete last supplied record, without merging fields. Preserve first-appearance ID order, not last-appearance order.
